canonical_title: Motorist data collection for store parking
abstract: Finding a free space is a huge problem for outdoor parking lots in Thailand and no obvious solution exists yet. The team built a video detection system that uses a Logitech HD C270 webcam and computer vision to monitor an outdoor parking area. Users draw rectangles over the camera feed to define parking slots, and the system marks each slot green when it is available or red when a car occupies it. A monitor screen summarizes the total, available and unavailable spaces and keeps a history log for each rectangle. The system stores hourly counts in a Google Firebase realtime database and was implemented in Python with OpenCV and NumPy on Google Colab. Eight test runs produced detection accuracy between 80 and 100 percent.

canonical_title: Line Bot for Printing Tax Invoice
aliases: Artificial Intelligence for printing the tax of gas station
abstract: The number of people filling gas at the gas station and request for the tax invoice has been increased recently, is one of the services that people often use. So, I decided to create this project, which is a printing tax invoice by Line Bot, an artificial intelligence for printing tax invoice of filling gas. I would say that the uniqueness of my Line Bot can reduce the wait time of the gas station's customer to get the tax invoice. I designed my Line Bot base on the user who is an owner or employees in the gas station. I provided the user with my two main features. The first one is printing, which allows the user to search by taxpayer number and print the tax invoice. Secondly, config the gas price, which allows the user to update the gas price that can be change every day, which allows users who is an owner or a manager. I also evaluated our system by sample group of people to give back the feedback after experience through my Line Bot.
course_evidence: Line Bot for Printing Tax Invoice; CS3200 SENIOR PROJECT II; FINAL REPORT

abstract: Hydroponic is a method in agriculture that has grown more popular among farming entrepreneurs and enthusiasts. However, many entrepreneurs and recreational farmers face the problem of controlling the water solution quality within the system: the electrical conductivity (EC) and pH value of the water. To address this problem, we have developed a Hydroponic Fertilizer Controller (HFC) along with a mobile application to fulfil the task of measuring and controlling the level of the farm's EC and pH as they desired. The test conducted shows that the HFC can manage the EC and pH value at user-specified multiple levels at a satisfactory level. We also conduct experiment by install the system into a real farm, Mai Nam Farm, with the result which satisfied the farm owner.

Homeless dogs taken into animal shelters are difficult to match with suitable adopters, and shelter staff often keep adopter records as paper copies. The team built the Animal Adoption website, where adopters register, browse animals in a shelter, and send adoption requests that administrators approve or reject through automatic email notifications. A questionnaire built on eight dog breed characteristics recommends appropriate dogs to each adopter, and a follow up tracking function reminds administrators to check the status of adopted dogs twice a year. The system was written in C#, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with Visual Studio, stores data and pictures in SQL Server and FireStorage, sends email through SendGrid, and runs on Microsoft Azure.
